mapper.select: SELECT sheet_id, title, sheet_file, music_key, difficulty, comment_text, stroke, created_at, writer_userid FROM sheet_table ORDER BY sheet_id DESC
SELECT sheet_id, title, sheet_file, music_key, difficulty, comment_text, stroke, created_at, writer_userid FROM sheet_table WHERE sheet_id = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sheet_table ( title, sheet_file, music_key, difficulty, comment_text, stroke, writer_userid ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{sheetFile}, #{musicKey}, #{difficulty}, #{commentText}, #{stroke}, #{writerUserid} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sheet_table SET title = #{title}, sheet_file = #{sheetFile}, music_key = #{musicKey}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, comment_text = #{commentText}, stroke = #{stroke}, writer_userid = #{writerUserid} WHERE sheet_id = #{sheetId},
